players.product: AI data center power: sidecar (out-of-rack) power, in-rack power supplies for centralized and distributed architectures, energy-storage compensation; SST in development

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue RMB 6,061,004,622.08, up 29.68% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 252,070,426.76, up 45.21%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 118,191,464.60, down 16.13%; operating profit RMB 27,297.77 ten-thousand, up 27.03%. The company says all six business groups grew, with the power segment growing most on data center demand, while tight supply of some upstream raw materials in the power electronics industry lowered gross margin slightly.

Power products segment revenue RMB 1,841,320,279.80 in H1 2026, up 60.92% YoY and 30.38% of company revenue; gross margin 25.06%, up 2.62 points. The company says its data center and network power business keeps winning project demand and orders from a North American AI major customer, Ericsson, Cisco, Juniper, Arista and Accton; its data center and server custom power projects moved from development into delivery from the second half of 2025, and fast-growing customer orders turned into revenue in H1 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Power revenue RMB 1,841,320,279.80 (+60.92%), 30.38% of revenue; gross margin 25.06% (+2.62 pts)

quarterly_data.signal: AI data center power: the company says it covers technology-solution leaders, system integrators and internet cloud vendors, has obtained supply qualification across them and has made continuous batch deliveries since Q1 2026. As one of NVIDIA's designated recommended data-center power providers it is taking part in the design of power systems and HVDC power solutions for NVIDIA Blackwell, Vera Rubin and next-generation data center architectures, and it is in the supply chains of several large international cloud vendors with customized AI data center power projects. In H1 2026 it began batch deliveries on project demand to some large North American customers and continues custom projects with several leading North American cloud vendors; in China it has broken through with leading domestic cloud vendors and passed qualification with most server makers. It has over 1000 technical staff on AI data center power.
quarterly_data.figure: Continuous batch deliveries since Q1 2026; over 1000 AI data center power technical staff

quarterly_data.signal: Product specifications the company states: its sidecar rectifies three-phase 380V to 480V AC into 800VDC beside the rack, with over 1MW per rack; its SST (in development) takes grid high-voltage input and outputs 800VDC with expected conversion efficiency over 98.5%; its low-voltage AC-DC and 800V-50V DC-DC power shelves are compatible with the MGX ecosystem and ORv3 and are mainly air-cooled, with a liquid-cooled version in development; its CRPS modules (AC and 800VDC input) reach 5kW and above; its PDB takes 800VDC input and steps down to 50V, 12V or 6V; it also offers 800VDC and 50V BBU shelves, 50V CBS supercapacitor shelves and AC EDPP compensators.
quarterly_data.figure: Sidecar over 1MW per rack; SST expected efficiency over 98.5%; CRPS 5kW and above

quarterly_data.signal: R&D expense RMB 621,383,159.33 in H1 2026, up 20.91% YoY and 10.25% of revenue; about 3,400 R&D engineers (34.6% of staff) across 10 R&D centers. A dedicated AI data center power system test laboratory at its Changsha global R&D center is about to be completed.

Direct overseas revenue RMB 21.80 hundred million in H1 2026, up 45.49% YoY and 35.97% of total revenue; indirect overseas revenue was over 7% of total, so revenue from overseas demand (direct plus indirect) was about 43%.
quarterly_data.figure: Direct overseas revenue RMB 21.80 hundred million (+45.49%), 35.97% of revenue

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity: six manufacturing bases (Zhuzhou, Taizhou, Hangzhou, Heyuan and Yiwu in China, and Rayong in Thailand) plus local delivery in India through a local OEM. In Thailand phase one of its own plant is in use and phases two and three are progressing on plan. Inventory rose to RMB 3,586,768,426.98 at June 30, 2026, mainly because orders increased and the company expanded production and stocked up; construction in progress was RMB 352,350,551.47.
quarterly_data.figure: Inventory RMB 3,586,768,426.98; construction in progress RMB 352,350,551.47
